summary.text: Tim Anderson is a nonpartisan candidate for Nebraska State Senate District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election, for an open seat, facing Janell Anderson Ehrke.
Anderson said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is the mayor of Sutton, Nebraska, and a farmer.

paragraphs.text: Tim Anderson graduated from Clay Center Public High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska at Kearney in 2007.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working in agriculture.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Anderson described himself as a husband, father of five and Republican, and named tax relief, opposition to abortion and agriculture among his policy interests.
Anderson finished first in the May 12, 2026 primary for District 38 with 34.6 percent of the vote.
